description: This file defines the ProductOptionValueService interface, which declares methods for managing ProductOptionValue entities, including CRUD operations and retrieval based on various criteria within an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: ProductOptionValueService

methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductOptionValues matching the given name within a store and language context.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOptionValue by its ID within a store context.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all ProductOptionValues associated with a store in a specific language.

methods.name: listByStoreNoReadOnly
